errors.text: The proposed Si or Al addition does not reconstruct the demonstrated 4.2 at.% Cr intervention, and the cited evidence does not establish that minor Si or Al additions to HfMoTaTiZr will produce a Laves phase rather than silicides, aluminides, or other phases.
The baseline ductility is incorrectly stated as below 5% or as uniform elongation, whereas the relevant room-temperature compression baseline has approximately 11.6% fracture strain.
The predicted outcomes use unsupported strength and ductility values and conflate tensile uniform elongation with compression fracture strain.
The control experiment does not isolate solid-solution hardening from the phase-structure mechanism because alloy chemistry and phase formation change simultaneously.
